title: Procol Console
messages: No bids placed yet.Click hereto view response template.

effects.does: Copies the displayed project information to the clipboard.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event record changes.
effects.leadsTo: Stays here
effects.check: Click Copy and verify that the expected project information is available in the clipboard.

effects.does: It copies the associated value to the clipboard.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event data changes.
effects.leadsTo: stays here
effects.check: Click the copy icon and verify the associated value is available on the clipboard.

effects.does: It asks Clara to analyze the project data.
effects.affects: Clara starts the awarding analysis flow and may initiate awarding.
effects.leadsTo: the awarding flow or the returned redirect URL
effects.check: Click Ask Clara and verify the awarding analysis response and redirect behavior.

effects.does: It starts creating a new version of the project.
effects.affects: A new editable project version is created from the current project.
effects.leadsTo: the project creation screen
effects.check: Click Create New Version and verify the create screen opens with the new-version context.

effects.does: It opens the project communication hub.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event data changes.
effects.leadsTo: the Messages view or chat drawer
effects.check: Click Messages and verify the project communication interface opens.

effects.does: It opens the project settings view.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event data changes until a setting is edited.
effects.leadsTo: the project settings view
effects.check: Click Settings and verify the project settings interface is displayed.

effects.does: It opens the project actions menu.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event data changes.
effects.leadsTo: the actions menu
effects.check: Click Actions and verify the available project actions are listed.

effects.does: It opens the response-progress view represented by the current count and percentage.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event data changes.
effects.leadsTo: the responses view or response-progress panel
effects.check: Click 0 / 186 0% and verify the response-progress destination or panel opens.

effects.does: It opens the response template.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event data changes.
effects.leadsTo: the response template view
effects.check: Click Click here and verify the response template is displayed.

effects.does: It switches to the Project Details tab.
effects.affects: The displayed project-details section changes to the details tab.
effects.leadsTo: the Project Details tab on this page
effects.check: Click Project Details and verify its content is rendered and the tab becomes selected.

effects.does: It switches to the Technical Stage tab.
effects.affects: The displayed stage content changes to the technical-stage event.
effects.leadsTo: the Technical Stage tab on this page
effects.check: Click Technical Stage and verify the technical-stage content is rendered.

effects.does: It switches to the RFQ tab.
effects.affects: The displayed stage content changes to the RFQ event.
effects.leadsTo: the RFQ tab on this page
effects.check: Click RFQ and verify the RFQ-stage content is rendered.

effects.does: It switches to the Master QCS tab.
effects.affects: The displayed content changes to the master QCS view.
effects.leadsTo: the Master QCS tab on this page
effects.check: Click Master QCS and verify the master QCS content is rendered.

effects.does: It switches the selected stage subtab to Responses.
effects.affects: The stage details display changes to response data.
effects.leadsTo: the Responses view on this page
effects.check: Click Responses and verify response content is displayed and the tab is selected.

effects.does: It switches the selected stage subtab to Overview.
effects.affects: The stage details display changes to overview information.
effects.leadsTo: the Overview view on this page
effects.check: Click Overview and verify overview information is displayed and the tab is selected.

effects.does: It switches the selected stage subtab to Participants.
effects.affects: The stage details display changes to participant data.
effects.leadsTo: the Participants view on this page
effects.check: Click Participants and verify the participants panel is displayed and the tab is selected.

effects.does: It switches the selected stage subtab to Participant Remarks.
effects.affects: The stage details display changes to participant remarks.
effects.leadsTo: the Participant Remarks view on this page
effects.check: Click Participant Remarks and verify participant remarks are displayed and the tab is selected.

effects.does: It opens the list of users or teams the project is shared with.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event data changes.
effects.leadsTo: the Shared With drawer or view
effects.check: Select Shared With and verify the sharing information is displayed.

effects.does: It opens a form to extend the submission deadline.
effects.affects: A later save can change the event's submission timing.
effects.leadsTo: the Extend Submission Time dialog
effects.check: Select Extend Submission Time and verify the deadline-extension dialog opens.

effects.does: It opens the withdrawal confirmation form.
effects.affects: A later confirmation can change the project status to withdrawn and submit withdrawal remarks or attachments.
effects.leadsTo: the Withdraw Project dialog
effects.check: Select Withdraw and verify the withdrawal dialog opens with its confirmation control.

effects.does: It opens the project's order activity history.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event data changes.
effects.leadsTo: the Order Activity view or drawer
effects.check: Select Order Activity and verify order-related activity is displayed.

effects.does: It opens a form to edit the evaluation time.
effects.affects: A later save can change the event's evaluation schedule.
effects.leadsTo: the Edit Evaluation Time dialog
effects.check: Select Edit Evaluation Time and verify the evaluation-time editor opens.

effects.does: It cannot be selected because the request-for-re-evaluation action is disabled.
effects.affects: No re-evaluation request is created or changed.
effects.leadsTo: stays here
effects.check: Verify the control is disabled and that clicking it does not open a dialog or trigger a request.

effects.does: It navigates to the parent Project page.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event data changes.
effects.leadsTo: the project page
effects.check: Click Project and verify the parent project page opens.

cases.title: Open the withdrawal confirmation without completing withdrawal
steps: Inspect the withdrawal dialog without entering a remark or adding an attachment.
cases.expected: The withdrawal dialog opens. "Withdrawal Remarks" is marked with *. The confirmation action is disabled while the remark is blank and no attachment is added.
cases.setup: Use a project that can be withdrawn.

The blank-form confirmation action cannot be reliably checked as disabled because its visible control name is not supplied or confirmed.
